description: Scoped module-type declaration for this directory only (Stage 10 Phase 9) -- eliminates Node's MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON warning when running this directory's own test suite directly under plain `node`. Does not affect workers/intel-gateway/package.json or wrangler's build (wrangler/esbuild resolve ESM syntax on their own, independent of this field). Scoped intentionally: Node resolves module type from the nearest package.json to each file, so this has zero effect outside this directory.
